backfillRows.why: equipment-3595 prints "You can draw deeply upon the untapped reserves of primal magic within it" and "visible primal energy surges over the armor for the duration". The 'items' entry's tradition is a majority vote over the held spells' own tradition lists; Haste is arcane/occult/primal, one vote each, and the stable sort keeps 'arcane', so the Spells page labelled a primal-infused armour Arcane. New Item.heldSpellTradition states the printed tradition and wins over the vote.

findings.note: DELIBERATE DEVIATION from the finding's proposal, stated in the report: the proposal replaces heldSpells with innateSpells because innateSpells is the only carrier of ours that holds a tradition. Print makes this an item ACTIVATION ("Activate 2 actions; Frequency once per day; Effect You cast Haste targeting yourself"), which is exactly what heldSpells + activationCost + the freq counter model, and WG's INNATE encoding is their engine's shape rather than the printed rule. Adding the tradition to the existing carrier keeps the item entry, its activation cost and its charge sync, is one line of engine, and is reusable by every other heldSpells item whose tradition is misvoted. No heldSpells/innateSpells double-grant is possible because heldSpells is untouched.
